description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Twisting Roots. While shifted, the ground in a 10 feet circle around you is 3 for your enemies. When a creature starts its turn in that area or enters it for the first time on a turn, you can use your Reaction to force it to make a Strength Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failure, its Speed is reduced to 0 until the end of your next turn.
  • Fey Step. As a Bonus Action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Formshift Damage and you regain all expended uses on a Long Rest. Alternatively, you can spend a 2nd Level Spell Slot to use this feature again.
  • Addling Spores. As an Action, you launch a cloud of befuddling spores at a location within 30 feet of you. Each creature within a 10 feet radius sphere around that point has to make a Constitution a Saving Throw or be Confused until the end of your next turn.
  • You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Formshift Damage and you regain all expended uses on a Long Rest. Alternatively, you can spend a 3rd Level Spell Slot to use this feature again.
